# Patel Rudra

> Patel Rudra is a full-stack web developer based in Surat, Gujarat, India. Patel Rudra builds web applications, landing pages and desktop tools with React, TypeScript, Node.js, Supabase, MongoDB and Python.

## Projects

- [Brew & Bean](https://cafe-landing-page-ashy.vercel.app): A cafe landing page built with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion. Source code: https://github.com/patelrudra0106-art/cafe-landing-page
- [Travel Website Landing Page](https://travel-website-landing-page-iota.vercel.app/): A responsive travel agency landing page built with React, TypeScript, Vite and Tailwind CSS. Source code: https://github.com/patelrudra0106-art/travel-website-landing-page
- [SPACE-SURVIVOR](https://github.com/patelrudra0106-art/SPACE-SURVIVOR): A roguelike space shooter built with Python and Pygame. Source code: https://github.com/patelrudra0106-art/SPACE-SURVIVOR
- [Nova AI Assistant](https://github.com/patelrudra0106-art/Nova-AI-Assistant): A voice-controlled Windows assistant that opens apps, controls volume, sends WhatsApp messages, manages reminders and answers questions with a Groq-hosted LLM. Source code: https://github.com/patelrudra0106-art/Nova-AI-Assistant
